detail.description: The Role We’re looking for a sharp, self-driven SOC L2 Analyst to investigate complex threats, lead incident response, and strengthen detection across JioStar’s large-scale media and streaming infrastructure. Key Responsibilities ● Investigate and lead response for escalated / high-severity security incidents end-to-end. ● Perform threat hunting, log analysis, and forensics across endpoints, network, and cloud. ● Conduct malware analysis and extract actionable IoCs and TTPs. ● Tune SIEM rules, IDS signatures, DLP and XDR policies to reduce noise and improve ● coverage. ● Monitor cloud environments (AWS / Azure / GCP) for misconfigurations and active ● threats. ● Write incident reports and post-mortems; mentor L1 analysts. ● Recommend countermeasures to protect against malware attacks ● Collaborating with necessary teams to identify and mitigate malware attacks ● Follow up on timely closure of the tickets (within SLA) ● Liaise with RCA and provide future recommendations. ● Monitor for attacks, intrusions and unusual, unauthorized, or illegal activity Required Experience and Skillsets ● 4+ years of hands-on incident handling and SOC operations experience. ● Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related technical ● discipline or equivalent professional experience directly related to information ● security, cyber, or computer network defense. ● Strong proficiency with SIEM, IDS/IPS, XDR/EDR, DLP, IAM/ SSO, Active ● Directory. ● Deep knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and common attacker TTPs and tools. ● Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS), OS internals, and web ● concepts (APIs, Cookies, Proxies, Firewalls, VPNs, Load Balancers). ● Comfortable in fast-paced environments with rapid context-switching. ● Analytical mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and a genuine curiosity for new ● threats and techniques. Good to Have ● Cloud security experience — AWS, Azure, or GCP native security services. ● Python scripting for automation, log parsing, or detection workflows. ● Certifications: CEH, or equivalent cloud security certs. We're looking for two curious, detail-oriented interns to join our On-Platform Discovery Surfaces team. You'll work alongside the merchandising team to help the right content reach the right viewer every day. If you love thinking in themes, digging into catalogs and wondering why people watch what they watch, this internship is for you. Responsibilities: Content Curation & Tray Support Assist in building thematic content collections by mood, genre, era, language, cast and occasion to populate recommendation trays Research trends, festivals and upcoming tentpole moments, and suggest tray ideas for the team to review Help prepare and track tray requests with product and tech teams, and check that trays go live accurately and on time Support coordination with Content/Studio, Marketing, Product and Design teams on campaign execution Help plan catalogue marketing around cultural and topical events to boost catalogue consumption What You'll Learn How content discovery and recommendation trays work on a large streaming platform How merchandising, product, tech and marketing teams work together How to read engagement data and turn it into curation decisions Metadata, tagging and content management workflows Who We're Looking For Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in media, marketing, mass communication No prior experience required. Internships or projects in content, digital marketing or e-commerce are a plus A strong sense of content: you know your genres, follow trends and have an instinct for what audiences want to watch Working knowledge of Google Sheets and willingness to learn analytics Familiarity with regional language content is a plus You'll Thrive Here If You Can move between big-picture ideas ("what if we built a tray around 90s nostalgia?") and precise execution ("is this tag correctly mapped?") in the same day Are naturally curious about user behavior and why people watch what they watch Take ownership of small tasks and follow through Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. JioStar is building one of India's most ambitious consumer growth engines at the intersection of media, entertainment, sports, digital platforms, commerce, data and consumer engagement and we are looking for a VP – Consumer Value & Partnerships to build the external partner ecosystem for this BU. This is not simply a partnership acquisition role. You will be responsible for building a new consumer value business from the ground up — identifying where JioStar can create differentiated value, shaping the proposition, building the right portfolio of partners, structuring the economics and taking it from strategy to scaled execution. The role will require someone who can operate across consumer strategy, partnerships, commercial models, product and execution — with the ability to move seamlessly from identifying a strategic opportunity to ensuring the proposition works for millions of consumers. Key Responsibilities 1. Define the Consumer Value & Partnership Strategy Shape the strategic vision for how external partnerships can enhance the JioStar consumer proposition. Identify the consumer needs, occasions and categories where partnerships can create meaningful incremental value. Develop a clear point of view on where JioStar should play, which categories to prioritise and what types of partnerships will be differentiated. Build the roadmap for evolving from individual benefits and partnerships into a broader consumer value proposition. Identify opportunities to leverage JioStar's unique consumer, content and distribution assets in partnership propositions. Ensure the proposition is built around consumer value and relevance, rather than generic discounts and offers. Continuously evolve the strategy based on consumer behaviour, partner performance and market opportunities. 2. Build a High-Impact Portfolio of Partnerships Own the identification, prioritisation, negotiation and development of strategic partnerships across high-value consumer categories, including: Retail and commerce Food, dining and delivery Travel and hospitality Financial services, cards and payments Telecom and broadband Consumer technology and electronics Mobility Gaming and digital goods Live events, entertainment and ticketing Lifestyle and premium experiences Creator and community-led propositions Reliance / Jio ecosystem businesses Go beyond assembling a partner catalogue. Build a curated portfolio of anchor partnerships that creates clear reasons for consumers to engage more deeply with JioStar. 3. Create Differentiated Consumer Propositions Work closely with product, loyalty, data, marketing, content and business teams to translate partnerships into compelling consumer experiences. Explore propositions such as: Rewards and benefits Exclusive access and experiences Status-linked privileges Subscription and membership bundles Earn-and-burn constructs Co-created consumer propositions Commerce-linked benefits Sports and entertainment experiences Live event access Premium and personalised experiences Partner-funded value propositions 4. Build Innovative Partnership Economics Own the commercial thinking behind the partnership portfolio, working closely with finance and business teams to ensure propositions are both compelling for consumers and attractive for JioStar and its partners. Evaluate and structure models around: Partner-funded rewards and benefits Revenue share Cost per acquisition / engagement Redemption economics and breakage Incremental revenue Retention and engagement impact Cross-sell and upsell opportunities Campaign and proposition ROI Gross margin and contribution economics Long-term strategic value of the partnership 5. Build the Anchor Partnership Portfolio Create and own a high-priority pipeline of partnerships that can establish the proposition and demonstrate its value early. Identify the partnerships that can create the strongest consumer proposition around key JioStar moments and use cases, including: Major sports properties Flagship entertainment franchises Subscription and upgrade journeys Connected TV and household engagement Premium consumer experiences Commerce and everyday consumption occasions Prioritise fewer, high-impact partnerships over a large number of undifferentiated ones, particularly in the early stages. 6. Be the Senior Face of the Proposition Build long-term relationships with senior leaders across India's leading consumer brands and platforms. Engage CXO-level stakeholders and position JioStar as a strategic partner rather than simply a distribution or media channel. Create compelling partnership narratives that demonstrate mutual value. Negotiate complex, multi-party commercial arrangements. Identify opportunities for partnerships to extend beyond a single campaign into long-term strategic relationships. detail.description: •     End-to-End Campaign: Conceptualize, script, and execute high-impact promo campaigns for movie premieres, movie festivals, and regular weekend/weekday movie Slots.       •     Creative Excellence: Set the creative benchmark for the team. Ensure all promos are engaging, emotionally resonant, and perfectly aligned with the channel’s brand identity.       •     Post-Production Oversight: Supervise video editing, sound design, voice-over recording, and graphics/packaging to ensure a polished, world-class final product.       •     Operational Workflow: Oversee daily channel operations, ensuring smooth hand-offs between programming, OAP, and Presentation team for smooth playout. Qualifications & Requirements       •     Experience: 10 to 15 years of proven experience in the Media & Broadcasting industry, with a significant portion of that time spent in the Movie Promo / OAP team of a leading TV channel.       •     Location: Must be based in Mumbai (or willing to relocate immediately).       •     Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or Diploma in Mass Media, Communications, Film/Television Production, or a related field. Core Skills:       ◦     Exceptional copywriting and conceptualization skills.       ◦     Deep understanding of broadcast operations, playout systems, and channel packaging.       ◦     Strong technical knowledge of post-production workflows (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audio Mixing).       ◦     Leadership Traits: High emotional intelligence, capable of managing creative conflicts, handling high-pressure situations, and delivering constructive performance reviews to team members.
